students.title: Students
students.body: Everyone learning at {academy}. Search by name, admission number or a parent's phone.
students.count: {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}} shown
students.emptyBody: Add your first student. You can add their parents at the same time.
students.noResultsBody: Try part of a name, an admission number or the last digits of a parent's phone.
students.archivedEmptyBody: Archived students stay here for 90 days and can be restored.
students.error: We couldn't load students. Check your connection and try again.

permission.title: Students aren't part of your role
permission.body: Ask the owner of {academy} if you need to see students.

students.pickParent: To add a parent, open their child below, then choose Add parent.

form.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas, e.g. scholarship, sibling.
form.phoneInvalid: Enter a 10-digit mobile number or a number starting with +
form.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com
form.offline: You're offline. Changes need a connection.

add.title: Add student
add.body: Only the name is needed now. You can add the rest later.
add.limit: Your plan's student limit is reached. Ask the owner about upgrading.

duplicates.title: This parent may already be here
duplicates.body: {name} has the same phone or email and {count, plural, one {one child} other {# children}} at the academy.

profile.archivedBanner: Archived on {date}. Restore before {until} to bring them back to lists.
profile.archivedReadOnly: Archived students can't be changed. Restore them first.
profile.restoreClosed: The 90-day restore window has passed. The record is kept, read-only.
profile.noParents: No parent or guardian added yet.
profile.noClasses: Not in a class yet. Classes come with the timetable.

notFound.title: Student not found
notFound.body: They may have been removed from your view, or the link is wrong.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.conflict: Someone else changed this student. Reload to see their changes, then try again.

statusChange.title: Change status
statusChange.body: Status shows whether {name} is still learning here.
statusChange.reasonHint: For example: exams, moved city, course finished.
statusChange.consequenceClasses: {count, plural, =0 {They aren't in any class.} one {They stay in their class until the timetable is updated.} other {They stay in their # classes until the timetable is updated.}}
statusChange.consequenceFees: Fee changes for status come with Finance.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.body: They leave the student list and search. Their history is kept, and you can restore them for 90 days.
archive.restoreBody: They come back to the student list with their history.

undoFailed: Couldn't undo — someone changed this student meanwhile.

parents.primaryHint: The first person the academy contacts.
parents.unlinkBody: {name} stays at the academy with any other children. You can add them again later.
parents.whatsappField: The parent agreed to WhatsApp messages

health.restricted: Only the owner, admins and this student's teachers can see these notes. Every view is recorded.
health.fieldHint: Allergies, conditions, medicines, what to do in an emergency.
health.error: We couldn't load the notes. Try again.

consent.none: No consent recorded yet. Parents give consent when they join the Family Hub; you can also record a paper form.
consent.title: Record consent
consent.body: Record a consent form signed on paper or given in person. It shows in the history; parents still confirm in the Family Hub to use it.
consent.serviceRequired: Consent must include running classes, attendance and fees.

errors.network: We couldn't reach AcademyBee. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFound: This student is no longer available to you.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.archived: Archived students can't be changed. Restore them first.
errors.alreadyLinked: This parent is already linked to the student.
errors.limit: Your plan's student limit is reached.

fields.title: Custom fields
fields.body: Up to {max} extra details to keep for every student, such as belt colour or bus route.
fields.empty: No custom fields yet. Add the details your academy tracks.
fields.label: Name of the field
fields.tooMany: You have {max} fields already. Hide one to add another.
fields.readOnly: Only the owner can change custom fields.

teachers.body: Everyone who teaches at {academy}: signed-in staff, invited teachers and visiting coaches.

modes.name: Just their name (no sign-in)
